card.title: Get a ping when someone messages you?
card.why: Only for messages to you. Turn it off in the menu any time.

ios.title: First, put Soft Life on your home screen
ios.why: iPhones only send pings to games on the home screen.
steps: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari.
Tap Add to Home Screen, then Add.
Open Soft Life from your home screen and turn on Notifications in the menu.

toast.on: You'll get a ping when someone messages you.
toast.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's settings.
toast.cant: Couldn't turn notifications on right now.
